title: Teen Screen-Time Curfew Breach
dataSources: Canvas assignments (`canvas:assignment`), Khan Academy SAT practice (`khan:sat`), Family Link usage (`familylink:usage`), and OurHome chores (`ourhome:chore`).
app: Canvas LMS exports, Khan Academy SAT practice, Google Family Link screen-time data, and OurHome chore tracking streamed to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=familylink:usage session_minutes=*
| eval curfew_breach=if(date_hour>=22 AND session_minutes>0,1,0)
| stats sum(curfew_breach) as curfew_breaches, sum(session_minutes) as total_minutes by child_name app_name
| where curfew_breaches>0
| sort - curfew_breaches
description: Counts screen-time sessions that spill past the agreed evening cutoff.
value: Curfew enforcement works better as a transparent trend conversation than as a vague argument about one late night.
implementation: Use Family Link or exported screen-time events, define the household cutoff, and trend breaches by child and app.
visualization: Table of apps and children with curfew breach count.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which apps keep sneaking past the agreed bedtime screen limit.
